release_name: Live TV v4.0.0 — Sports Score Ticker, Radio Mode, EPG & Scheduled DVR
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ⚡ Real-Time Sports Score Ticker: Live running ticker bar at the top displaying instant cricket scores (runs, wickets, overs), football scores, and Bangladesh Standard Time (BST) match times with 1-click channel tuning
🚨 Instant Goal & Wicket Celebration Toasts: Automatic detection of goals and wickets from live telemetry that pops a flash celebration notification with a 'Watch Live' quick switch button

📻 Audio-Only / Radio Mode (85%+ Battery & CPU Saver): Disables video decoding and displays an animated visualizer HUD on Mac and Phone, saving 85%+ CPU and battery for listening to matches, commentary, and news

⏱️ Background Scheduled DVR Recording: Schedule automatic recordings to ~/Movies/Live TV Recordings/ with custom start delays (instant, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h overnight) and match durations (up to 3h full match)
📺 Realistic EPG 'Now & Next' Timeline: Dynamic Electronic Program Guide progress bars and show titles displayed on every channel card and inside the player overlay
🔒 Kids Safe Mode & Parental PIN Lock: 4-digit PIN lock (default: 0000) that filters the catalog to family, animation, nature, and sports channels while blocking adult and violence content
💾 Cross-Device Backup & Cloud Sync: Export and import all ranked favorites, custom M3U playlists, and settings to a portable JSON backup file
⚡ Ultra-Low Latency Mode: 1-click buffer optimizer reducing live broadcast lag to ~2s behind live for real-time sports synchronization
